meta.name: Đạo tràng Phật Hào · Soft community dashboard
meta.description: Measured soft reference adapted to a clear staff management hierarchy: scoped filters, approved/group/pending KPIs, direct review access, bounded analytical panels and detailed records. The current composition follows the user’s request for clearer information grouping.

color.palette_type: Cool neutral workspace with complementary coral and cyan focal cards

primary.role: Measured foreground for readable labels and metrics

secondary.role: Derived secondary foreground darkened from measured #909093 for readable small labels

accent.role: Measured blue for chart marks, focus and selected data; darker #2462ce for white-text actions

neutral.usage: Light to dark. Reference background #f5f6fa and foreground #0c0d0e used verbatim. Outer gray #cfd0db is a presentation frame in the source, not a 32%-width application border.

color.contrast_strategy: Near-black on cool light surfaces. Secondary text is darkened for legibility. Gradient cards use dark text and raw counts; color is never the only label.

brand_exceptions.logo: Keep original community logo and Đạo tràng → Phật Hào order
brand_exceptions.focal_cards: Blue approved total, amber pending work; three communities receive equal-weight neutral cards.
brand_exceptions.status: Approval and activity colors retain readable labels
brand_exceptions.shell_surfaces: Topbar/right sidebar white; left sidebar uses existing #eef1f8 surface-hover token; main canvas stays measured #f5f6fa. Stronger rules visually separate regions without dark ornamental panels.

accessibility_adjustments.usage: Pending-series stroke, darker for visibility on a light plot

typography.font_style_notes: Self-hosted Geist with Vietnamese coverage; reference font identity unknown. Overview uses 40px total and 32px subgroup counts with tabular numerals; body remains 13–14px.

spacing.content_density: Comfortable analytics with compact operational tables and focused forms
spacing.section_rhythm: 24px between work areas, 12px between KPI cards, 16px between analytical panels; existing responsive content gutters.

layout.grid_system: Labeled filter panel, equal-weight total/three-community/pending KPI row, expandable review area, two clearly bounded analytics panels and full-width detailed sheet. Continuous topbar and both sidebars remain.

columns.summary: Five aligned KPIs; below 800px available width, total/pending row then three equal community cards
columns.analytics: 1.45fr / 1fr overview, stacked below 800px available column width; group statistics unchanged

layout.alignment_tendency: Asymmetric left-to-right analysis, aligned edges; no artificial screenshot outer frame

shape.border_usage: Minimal card borders, hairline list separators, precise table rules and focus boundaries
shape.divider_style: Fine cool-gray rules between review entries and analytical columns

elevation.depth_cues: White total surface on cool canvas, colored focal cards, gray children strip, restrained depth for overlays

iconography.style: Fine Lucide outlines; translucent utility squares only within two focal cards

motion.philosophy: Functional only; all animation and transitions disabled for reduced-motion preference

components.button_style: Readable blue commits, quiet utility controls, three peer community filter cards with pressed/focus feedback, and an actionable pending KPI.
components.input_style: White fields with soft corners; pill-shaped filter selectors and search; fine focus boundaries
components.card_style: 20px neutral panels and compact metric cards. Blue total, amber pending work, neutral peer community cards with color dots. Distinct filters, analytics and records; no decorative gradient KPI mosaic.
components.navigation_pattern: Flat white continuous topbar, 72px desktop / 60px mobile, fine bottom divider and no drop shadow. Larger original logo/wordmark; staff identity and role form one quiet account control with dark circular initials. Pale blue-gray left sidebar, cool main canvas and white right sidebar retain clear dividing rules. No path/breadcrumb. Existing collapse, menu keyboard behavior and accessible mobile drawer remain.
components.modal_style: Centered opaque white native dialog, 22px corners, 24px padding, bounded viewport, Escape and focus return preserved
components.list_style: Right-side latest pending names link to actual profiles; full review stays available. Detailed sheet preserves filtering, sorting, resize, select, export and pagination.
components.component_notes: Group KPIs have equal width and aligned numbers. Pending opens full review before charts. Six shared selects replace the month strip. Two-level analytical headers align. Existing table, chart and form behavior remains.

visual_language.ornamentation: Small semantic color accents and sparse chart dots only
visual_language.whitespace_usage: Open analytics and clear grouping, with compact records below
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: Approved total and pending work anchor a compact aligned KPI row; charts and detailed records have distinct labeled panels.
visual_language.focal_strategy: Data scope, approved total, pending actions, trends, records
visual_language.contrast_level: dark-on-light dominant, low contrast structural borders
visual_language.texture_usage: Static sparse SVG dots clipped to chart area only

composition.hierarchy_method: Numeric scale, asymmetric columns, surface and color grouping
composition.balance_type: Asymmetric analytical focal area within a consistent content grid
composition.grouping_strategy: Filters → current counts → pending review → analysis → full records
composition.negative_space_role: Separate functional areas without adding empty presentation framing

imagery.photo_treatment: Existing portraits kept; no decorative stock photography
imagery.graphic_elements: Peer community dots, actual monthly series, distribution tracks, original logo and functional portraits.

interaction_feel.feedback_style: immediate selected state and clear loading/empty/error states
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: Quiet neutral row and utility hover; blue focus outline; delayed tooltip
interaction_feel.loading_style: Static placeholders and spinner only during a request
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: Only existing workflow feedback, focus, progress and data tooltip

brand_voice_in_ui.tone: calm and helpful Vietnamese appropriate to Đạo Tràng
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: explain available next steps without fabricated data

overview.fallback_strategy: Native content and static CSS/SVG remain fully usable with reduced motion
overview.primary_technology: Static CSS radial gradients and responsive SVG data charts

background_effects.description: Flat cool canvas and opaque cards; gradient-card mosaic replaced by equal-weight administrative KPIs

canvas_drawings.description: Use responsive static SVG area chart; existing image crop canvas remains functional, not a visual effect

svg_animations.description: SVG chart and icons are static; tooltip follows pointer/focus without SVG animation

visual_effects.composite_notes: Static CSS surfaces with semantic accents; responsive SVG curves pass through actual monthly observations with no overshoot. Sparse plot dots and functional tooltips only. No overview ring or gradient-card mosaic; group statistics retain composition. No animation loops, shaders or decorative rendering dependencies.
